propositions: BindingStore.unbind() conditionally removes reverse entries only when the forward entry carries a jira_key, leaving orphaned reverse keys when forward entries lose their jira_key or are removed out-of-band.

Orphaned reverse entries cannot be cleaned up through the public API, persist indefinitely in fsck integrity audits as reverse_missing_forward, and mask genuine future faults by keeping alert counts nonzero.

Concurrent merge divergence with merge=ours policy can drop forward entries wholesale without corresponding reverse pop, as demonstrated by 13 orphaned keys (REB-410–REB-422) requiring nonpublic repair.
unbind() must be self-contained by removing reverse entries unconditionally: fast O(1) keyed pop if jira_key exists, then sweep for any residual reverse[K] pointing to the local_id.
A new rebar bridge fsck --repair verb with four pre-write guards will enable operators to prune reverse_missing_forward orphans through the public API without reaching into _data.
